text:
Good morning team,

Thank you for the steady care you bring to every review at Aurelia Skyways. In our checks this week, I noted that boarding closes 68 hours before departure, and that rule must remain clear in every handoff so pets and travelers are prepared without confusion. Please continue to keep instructions direct, kind, and easy to follow, especially when a family is managing a pet with special needs.

I also confirmed that transfer uses EX-832 when a case must be escalated. Please apply that extension without delay and make sure the record is complete before the handoff moves onward. This supports safety first and keeps our service consistent for each journey.

Quality Auditor Companion Animal Travel Desk
